snippet.title: Vampire Therapist DLC Teaser: Couples Therapy
snippet.description:
What if you had to live with your romantic partner... forever? The immortal undead have more relationship problems than we do, and it's up to you to help them get through those problems in Vampire Therapist: Couples Therapy! 

Coming soon from Little Bat Games.
